audience.text: Python developers building automation tools, reporting systems, or presentation generators that need to manipulate PowerPoint files programmatically.

capabilities.text: Create new presentations from scratch or open existing .pptx files, add or remove slides, clone slides, and save to multiple Office Open XML formats.
capabilities.title: Presentation creation and editing

capabilities.text: Add and position shapes including auto shapes, picture frames, tables, connectors, and group shapes; manage shape properties like fill, line, effects, and 3D formatting.
capabilities.title: Shape and content modeling

capabilities.text: Format text at portion, paragraph, and text frame levels with font properties, bullet styles, alignment, and fill formats; support for tri-state booleans via NullableBool.
capabilities.title: Text formatting and styling

capabilities.text: Create charts with 74 types, embed an XLSX workbook for series and category data, add trendlines, error bars, legends, titles, and data labels.
capabilities.title: Chart creation and data binding

capabilities.text: Apply 57 transition types including Morph transitions, configure timing and triggers, and build animation sequences with motion paths and effects.
capabilities.title: Slide transitions and animations

capabilities.text: Embed images from file paths, streams, or bytes using Images.from_file or Images.from_stream, and add them as picture frames to slides.
capabilities.title: Image and media embedding

capabilities.text: Set built-in and custom document properties such as title, author, keywords, and custom key-value pairs.
capabilities.title: Document properties and metadata

capabilities.text: Export presentation text content to Markdown format with support for text frames, tables, lists, headings, comments, and chart data.
capabilities.title: Export to Markdown

limitations.text: No rendering or conversion to PDF, HTML, XPS, or image formats is supported; the library only writes OOXML and Markdown.
Reading is limited to .pptx; other SaveFormat values such as Ppt, Pdf, Xps, Odp, Html, Swf, Otp raise ValueError at save time.
SmartArt, OLE objects, mathematical text, VBA macros, and digital signatures are not implemented and raise NotImplementedError.
Presentation sections are not implemented; there is no public API to read or change slide size.
Comment threads are written using only the classic comment-list schema; modern thread format features are not represented.
TextAnimation.add_effect is explicitly stubbed and raises NotImplementedError.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and modification of PowerPoint presentations using pure Python, eliminating dependency on Microsoft Office or COM interop.
Supports embedding images, tables, charts, shapes, connectors, and speaker notes into presentations through a consistent object model.
Provides full control over text formatting, bullet styles, and paragraph structure at the portion level.
Allows embedding and manipulating charts with embedded workbook data and applying slide transitions and animations.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for Python is an open-source Python library for creating, reading, and editing PowerPoint .pptx presentations without requiring Microsoft Office.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports reading or writing .ppt (legacy PowerPoint format) is not explicitly stated.
The exact set of chart types supported beyond the 74 named in ChartType is unclear.
Whether 3D shapes beyond basic extrusion and bevel are fully supported is not detailed.
The behavior of saving to unknown XML parts when round-tripping is described but not quantified.
Whether threaded comments preserve all reply metadata in modern formats is uncertain.
The exact set of supported Markdown export flavors beyond 24 is not specified.
Whether custom dash patterns for lines are fully supported is not detailed.
The exact set of supported image formats beyond .png is not specified.

workflows.name: Open and save presentation
workflows.text: Open an existing .pptx file using Presentation as a context manager, inspect slides, and save changes back to .pptx format.

workflows.name: Add shapes and text
workflows.text: Create new presentations, add auto shapes with text frames, and format text at portion level with font properties and fill colors.

workflows.name: Embed images and build tables
workflows.text: Add images from file handles or bytes to the image collection and insert them as picture frames; create tables with rows and columns and populate cells.

workflows.name: Build charts with embedded data
workflows.text: Add charts to slides, access the embedded workbook, define series and categories, and populate data points for bar, line, and other chart types.

workflows.name: Apply transitions and animations
workflows.text: Configure slide show transitions with type, timing, and triggers; add animation sequences and effects to shapes using behavior factories.

workflows.name: Manage comments and notes
workflows.text: Add speaker notes to slides and create threaded comments with authors, positions, and timestamps.
